- **Subject:** "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** gives the $2,101 per-seat rate, says Marcus provided it and that Anselm approved sharing it with Hollis.

Normally Hollis couldn't be given this rate without approval. As CFO, Anselm can approve finance figures, and his message did that, so I didn't need a separate `request_approval`.

I took the $2,101 figure from Anselm's message and didn't check it against what Marcus originally said. Marcus's messages aren't in any conversation Anselm can see, so I didn't read them for him.
